book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yesu peti xel gyovaxa wei lalo yo
Woyom Yesu neil wou xel qendu ngandoung on is e xe xel betiyeing,
“Xel putoung wei petieing me xel Parisi eno mindei lek Mose xe sia.
Om xam a mi betiwou xel me ghe bong lul dalus wei xel neil wou xam o. Ekom xam seng bong vati wei xel wong o, en nambei xel se mi wong e teyei lek vati wei xel mi teyoxe yo.
Xel tup nimaying ngandoung me toung lek xel xomaxoneing on ghandiwek, ekom xel venaxow se teyei bei zeim lek angya memend deyis bei bong ena veil.
“Lul sapa wei xel mi wong en embei xel xomaxoneing gyei, me lek xel dambend me memend eno xel mi tup deneing wei xoulek o lek me e wo myasapa, me mi tup yis ding lek xel xe teimb ding myasepu.
Xel laleind mi vind bei na mi mendei mya eivek bouk wei mata ngandoung o me eivek xomek qekueing ama lalei.
Xel laleind mi vind bei moux alis vex a mi neil bendiyeing wou xel eivek beyeeng vateivek me na mi taxe e bei ‘Putoung.’
“Ekom xam eno xel se taxe xam ‘Putoung,’ en xam xe putoung tixemou tateis me xam dalus on limim ama.
De xam se taxe xelti lek tembuing bei ‘mang,’ en xam Mamim tixemou, me e toundei eivek tyoung gheyapu nei.
O xel ti se taxe xam ‘putoung,’ en xam xe putoung tixemou, inyon Kilisi.
Xam xe teiv eivek xam senghoing eno e mi mendei nambei xam xe xukxe.
En wangwei eti yeiw embei sanghoxe xow on tyek e lei detei eivek, de eti embei beoux xow on tyek e lei zekna.

“Xam putoung wei petieing me xam Parisiyeiw, xam ghe gwaleeng amim, xam wei myamim yuw o! Xam on ghe mi toung xomek mya wei tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu nei yo zeyi moux alis vex mend. Xam venaxow seng la eivek, me xam ghe mi nale zeyi xel wei di wong me yei en embei na eivek o.

[Xam putoung wei petieing me xam Parisiyeiw, xam ghe gwaleeng amim, xam wei myamim yuw o, en xam ghe mi wo nol wou xel vexeiv bend, me xam ghe mi tyoing lek me ghe mi zeimemam ding, nambei nyon tyek xam a qou myaveweeng ngandoung.]

“Xam putoung wei petieing me xam Parisiyeiw, xam ghe gwaleeng amim, xam wei myamim yuw o! Xam ghe mi ghavineeng lek tembuing me mamileeng being bong tambiy tixemou bo betiyeing wei xam o, me gyeik e wong ambei betiyeing ti, eno xam ghe mi wong moux on la eivek nilul ngandoung eno ghanaw veil eivek nenyex wei luta yo nambei xam venaxow.

“Xam wei matekeing ambei talex sakwaing wou xomaxoneing bamba eno xam ghe gwaleeng amim. Xam ghe mi neimbei, ‘Wangwei tambiy ti na neil zonghek is inyapunei lek xomek vambuing, ond inyon se byexaxoun qayeeng. Ekom wangwei e neil zonghek is inyapunei lek ghol wei xomek vambuing o, ond inyon byexaxoun qayeeng.’
Xam on bandol me mamim tekeing! Tina inye ngandoung, ghol o xomek vambuing wei wong ghol wo vambuing o?

Xam ghe mi neil is ambei nyon bei, ‘Wangwei xelti e neil zonghek lek qeind is inyapunei ond inyon se byexaxoun qayeeng, ekom wangwei xelti neil zonghek is inyapunei lei lek xound wei toundei lek qeind, ond inyon byexaxoun qayeeng.’
Xam moux wei mamim tekeing o. Tina inye ngandoung, xound o qeind wei wong xound on wo vambuing o?
Nambei inyon, tambiy tiwei neil zonghek is inyapunei lei lek qeind on neil zonghek is inyapunei lei lek lulul dalus wei toundei lek o.
Me tiwei mi neil zonghek is inyapunei lei lek xomek vambuing eno neil lek tiwei mindei eivek o.
Me eti neil zonghek is inyapunei lei lek tyoung gheyapu eno neil lek Anutu xe siaking me tiwei mindei lek o.

“Xam putoung wei petieing me Parisiyeiw, xam ghe gwaleeng amim, xam wei myamim yuw o! Xam ghe wong ti eivek xoumeeng wei lul senyeing wei xuk lalei. Ekom xam ghe saing qayeeng ngandoung dalus wei petieing o veil, nambei qayeeng bombek, lalei pyaweing me wongeingis. Xam betiwou qayeeng ngandoung wei petieing ne yo dom xam naleimim se ma petieing bamba.
Xam wei mamim tekeing wei ghe mi talex sakwaing! Xam ghe mi tiy mamayek veil xam xe louk, ekom xam ghe lep kamel.

“Xam putoung wei petieing me Parisiyeiw, xam ghe gwaleeng amim, xam wei myamim yuw o! Xam ghe mi sekweyexe mayamya me dipek demi, ekom eivek lalei eno pup en kwa eivekeing me ghe mi wou kwamim ngenong en lulul leimalei.
Xam Parisiyeiw wei mamim tekeing o! Myaxeeng eno xam sekweyexe mayamya me dipek lalei bole, dekakom demi embo vako is.

“Xam putoung wei petieing me Parisiyeiw, xam ghe gwaleeng amim, xam wei myamim yuw o! Xam on nambei leiveeng meyeing wei xel pelei pen teleing lek o, wei wo nimza maseim lek demi yo, ekom lalei yon pup en xel meyeing kanzek me lul dalus wei nilaxes o.
Xam is ambei nyon eivek sakwaing kayon, eno xel mi yei xam lek demi om xel embeik nge xam on bombek, ekom xam laleimim on pup en kwa wei tyonyeing me kwa wei pyaweing lek qayeeng o.
“Xam putoung wei petieing me Parisiyeiw, xam ghe gwaleeng amim, xam wei myamim yuw o! Xam ghe ev leiveeng meyeing en xel poropetyeiw me ghe vunekwou leiveeng wei xel bombek o.
Me xam ghe neil, ‘Wangwei xa mendei eivek bouk wei xa bumiyeiw, tyek xa se teyei bei devind xel me na nyeis xel poropet a mey.’
Om xam venaxow ghe talex lek xow bei xam on neumambu wei xel wei leis poropetyeiw mey o.
Woyom xam la wong sewokeing teyei lek ingwei bumyeiw mi wong o.
“Xam on myeiy me myeiy nilul neuyeiw xam! Tyek xam a pek veil myaveweeng wei nenyex luta yon nambei nya?

Nambei nyon tyek a bong xel poropetyeiw me xel wei lundpeyei nimza me xel putoung wei petieing o nak wou xam. Xel valu tyek xam ghe nyeis xel a mey dom na tuw valu lek xax pepeeng, de xel valu tyek xam ghe bo nol wou xel eivek xomek qekueing ama me na tiy xel na beyeeng nge me na nge.

Om nambei nyon, xel dalus bombek gyand wei xel leis xel mey lek tembuing eno tyek mendei lek xam, qandi eivek Abel wei bombek o tax me e na Belekia neu moux Sakalias, tiwei xam ghe leis e mey eivek xomek vambuing me qeind senghoing o.
A neil wou xam zonghek, lul nimaying dalus tine tyek nam lek xam qendu ti gweimbeeng ne dalus.

“O Yerusalem, Yerusalem, xam eti yeiw wei ghe mi leis xel poropetyeiw me ghe nex xel wei lak wou xam en qakous. Taxombouk eno ambei mi qeku xam neumimyeiw lekti, nambei qouklex mi qekuwou neuyeiw eivek banis xeinghembi yo, ekom xam laleimim se vind.
Wei, xam xe xomek tyek lelolexe me mendei bandaing.
En a neil wou xam bei, tyek xam seng nox gwei a no qe ka xam a neimbei, ‘Mata ena wou e tiwei lam eivek Tambiy Ngandoung lei yo.’ ” Qapiya Lalo 118:26
